name: ToggleGroup
purpose: Coordinate related toggle-button commands with single or multiple pressed selection and one orientation-aware roving focus stop.
useWhen: Several related commands, such as alignment or formatting controls, should expose pressed state and navigate as one keyboard group.

avoidWhen.condition: The controls are unrelated, represent form answers, or turn settings on and off immediately.
avoidWhen.useInstead: individual Toggle controls, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup, or Switch

composition: Give Root an accessible group name, choose type=single or type=multiple, and compose uniquely valued Item parts with visible text or accessible labels.

rules.statement: Give Root a concise accessible name and every icon-only Item its own accessible command name.
Choose single when at most one command may be pressed and multiple for independent pressed commands; match controlled value and defaultValue shapes to that type.
Provide stable unique Item values and route controlled updates through onValueChange.
Preserve one roving Tab stop, disabled-item skipping, DOM-order registration, looping policy, orientation-specific Arrow keys, Home/End, and horizontal RTL mirroring.
Preserve each Item's button and aria-pressed behavior and Root's group behavior when using asChild or render.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using ToggleGroup for radio form answers, mixing string and array controlled values with the wrong type, or giving every Item a Tab stop.
commonMistakes.correction: Choose the correct semantic group, keep value shape aligned to type, and retain the owned roving-focus model.

validation: Verify Root and Item names, single and multiple controlled and uncontrolled state, unique values, pressed semantics, disabled Root and Items, pointer, Enter, Space, and selection callbacks.

Verify one roving Tab stop when selected and unselected, DOM-order changes, Arrow navigation by orientation, Home/End, loop boundaries, horizontal LTR/RTL, and native, asChild, and render composition.
